stories.title: Remains of N.B. sailor recovered nearly 80 years after plane crash
stories.summary: Nearly 80 years after a two-seat naval fighter crashed in Northern Ireland, the remains of a young man from New Brunswick have been recovered and identified.

stories.title: Nova Scotia man charged with attempted murder after alleged axe attack outside home
stories.summary: Police have charged a Nova Scotia man with attempted murder after he allegedly attacked another man with an axe.

stories.title: Weather alerts in effect due to heavy rain across N.S. and parts of N.B., N.L.
stories.summary: Heavy rain is set to hit Nova Scotia and much of New Brunswick and Newfoundland.

stories.title: N.S. government reaches new tentative deal with union representing school workers
stories.summary: The Nova Scotia government says it has reached a new tentative agreement with the union representing 5,500 school support workers in the province.

stories.title: Community groups blindsided as Ottawa closes refugee sponsorship program
stories.summary: The federal government has quietly pressed pause on a program that helped community groups sponsor and support refugees come to Canada.

stories.title: Former Tory minister Becky Druhan elected as N.S. Liberal party leader
stories.summary: Druhan is the party’s first permanent leader since the Liberals were steamrolled in the 2024 provincial election, dropping from 14 seats to just two.

stories.title: N.S. school support workers’ union seeks renewed talks after members reject offer
stories.summary: The union representing school support workers in Nova Scotia is calling on the provincial government to resume contract negotiations by noon on Monday.

stories.title: Nova Scotia marks Transgender Day of Remembrance with flag raising and poetry
stories.summary: The annual occasion honours transgender and gender-diverse people whose lives were lost to anti-transgender violence and hatred.

stories.title: Donations pour in for residents displaced by Glace Bay fire and explosion
stories.summary: The community of Glace Bay, N.S. in Cape Breton is coming together to support those affected by a devastating fire and explosion on Commercial Street.

stories.title: New Brunswick adopts HPV testing for cervical cancer, Nova Scotia urged to follow
stories.summary: Nova Scotia's Official Opposition is calling on the province to quickly adopt HPV testing for cervical cancer and transition away from the traditional Pap test.
